newsitem.title: UK: PPM appoints new head of UK equities.
newsitem.headline: PPM appoints new head of UK equities.

text.p: Prudential Portfolio Managers (PPM) said on Monday it had appointed Nick Mustoe head of UK equities.
"At PPM, (Mustoe) will have responsibility for UK equity assets in excess of 32 billion pounds," Prudential said.
"In addition, his new role will encompass personal responsibility for the day-to-day management of a number of significant UK pension fund accounts."
One of the UK's largest investment managers, PPM has total assets under management worth 88.6 billion pounds.
It manages 11 billion pounds in segregated and managed pension fund assets for more than 400 external clients, and controls more than 3.5 percent of UK shares.
Mustoe, 34, has spent the last 11 years at Phillips & Drew Funds Management, where he managed more than 3.7 billion pounds for a number of UK pension fund accounts.

Apart from London, PPM has seven other investment offices worldwide, including Cape Town, Chicago, Hong Kong, Singapore, Sydney, Toronto and Wellington. --Caroline Brothers, London newsroom +44 171 542 2734; fax 0171 583 7239
